title: Nondegeneracy of the symplectic form
statement: Let $p$ be a prime, let $n$ be a natural number, and let $V=\mathbb{F}_p^n\times\mathbb{F}_p^n$ over the field of integers modulo $p$. The bilinear form $\omega((x,z),(x',z'))=\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}(x_i z'_i-z_i x'_i)$ is nondegenerate: if $\omega(u,v)=0$ for every $v\in V$, then $u=0$.
replaced:
Fix a prime $p$ and an integer $n$, and let $V = \bbf_p^n \times \bbf_p^n$ carry the
bilinear form
\[
\omega\big((x,z),(x',z')\big) \;=\; \sum_{i=1}^{n}\big(x_i z'_i - z_i x'_i\big)
\]
over the prime field $\bbf_p$. Then $\omega$ is non-degenerate: the only vector $u \in
V$ with $\omega(u,v) = 0$ for every $v \in V$ is $u = 0$.
